openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.minimumMissingRecord: Wish-owned complete finite outcome definitions for multiple substantive reality changes, not a cosmetic-only or borrowed-lower-spell-only substitute. For each, define intended benefit, affected identities, actual targets/geometry within the native range contract, consent/resistance and defenses, physical/material/resource premises, permitted operations, exact result and authority provenance. No specific creation, transformation, emulation or history-edit algorithm is supplied by the broad native summary. Preserve an extension path for later explicit outcome authorship without treating demonstrated examples as a fixed maximum power list.

At least one substantial composite with an explicit dependency/order graph, preconditions, exact operation-level before/after states, and source-owned atomic versus partial settlement. Define illegal declaration versus paid interruption/opposition/partial success; physical aftermath versus continuing magic or deferred obligations; repetition, duplicate callbacks, actual source conflicts, suppression/resumption/termination and finite clocks. Preserve the initiating paid cast and irreversible consumed/unique resources, body/item identities, original history and lawful ownership/custody. Audit inverse operations are not an in-world rewind, repayment, free retry or new Wish privilege.

openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.contract: Legally acquired paid-use encounters and four-route coverage

This submission also requires demonstrated legal paid rank9 use for each native route: Cleric/Universal and Druid, Mage, Wizard/Transmutation. Multiple actors may appear in one encounter; no new class gate or in-game frequency is imposed. Bind complete actor profiles, class17+ acquisition/repertoire/preparation, actual budgets/RP/Dissonance/Refrain and relevant class history, affected source-qualified profiles and materials, permissions, range/line-of-effect and V/S/F. Commit the legal one-action cast and actual final price from base26RP before counters/results; preserve protected, uncertain, interrupted, opposed, repeat/conflict and ending branches with exact resources, clocks and custody. No such paid Wish witness is present. A labeled authored review encounter is not asserted as gameplay, and no campaign history is inferred.

wholeIdentityGate: Complete substantive reality changes and a composite are the native central effect, not optional external branches. Classification records cannot replace useful paid operation.
scopeOfFinite: Finite describes each explicit reviewable operation and its inputs/settlement. It is not a new blanket power ceiling, target-count cap or maximum Wish menu.
externalEvidenceScope: Use source/provenance records for only the chosen outcome facts, profiles, materials, permissions and protected exceptions. Universal cosmology, compulsory Hunt reversal, spell-copy mode, or time travel is not required for every Wish.
minimumNextAction: Supply versioned authorized outcome specifications for W01/W02 and the actual supporting facts; then W03 paid route-complete encounters. No repeated unchanged classification replay requested.
